_doc: Sentiment run registry (separate from configs/runs.json). A run (SR<NN>) is one fixed setup: data and training settings. Each model tried under it is a member SR<NN>-<model>. 'members' maps a result folder under results/sentiment/runs/ (with _seed<N> removed) to its run and model tag. 'run_data' gives each run on generated data its SG label and the corpus the set was generated for (D-029); real-only runs have no entry. src.sentiment.summarize_runs groups the score tables by this file. A member may carry its own 'generation' ("" = real only) when one run holds real-only and generated-data members (SR03-EESA).

runs.SR01: Real only (condition 1), S1 (ArSarcasm-v2), every roster classifier; BERTs 3 seeds, LLMs seed 42 first (SD-003)
runs.SR02: Real + SG01 (open, zero-shot synthetic; condition 2): S1 train + 6,000 tweets (500 per variety x sentiment cell) from one SG01 generator; BERTs 3 seeds; Jais-2 (QLoRA, SR01 recipe) 3 seeds. Member = <classifier>_<generator>. The Jais-2 set could not fill its cells and was not trained.
runs.SR03: Real only, NEU dropped: S1 train/dev/test without NEU tweets (6,069 / 675 / 2,252), 2-class NEG/POS head, every roster classifier, 3 seeds (SD-007). Macro F1 is over NEG/POS, not comparable with SR01/SR02.
runs.SR04: Real + SG02 (open, few-shot k=5 synthetic; condition 2): S1 train + 6,000 tweets (500 per variety x sentiment cell) from one SG02 generator (Fanar, Qwen3, Aya); the 7 BERTs, 3 seeds, SR02 recipe (D-020). Member = <classifier>_<generator>.
runs.SR05: Real + SG03 (targeted minimal pairs for the SR02 dev hard-case types, D-021; condition 3): S1 train + 4,000 texts (2,000 complete pairs) from one SG03 generator; 7 BERTs, 3 seeds, SR04 recipe. Member = <classifier>_<generator>.
runs.SR06: Real + SG03-random (size-matched untargeted minimal pairs, the control for SR05, D-021): S1 train + 4,000 texts from one SG03-random generator; 7 BERTs, 3 seeds, SR04 recipe. Member = <classifier>_<generator>.
runs.SR07: Real + SG04 (targeted minimal pairs for the SR02 TEST hard-case types, D-023: TEST-CONTAMINATED, test scores are leakage analysis, not a result): S1 train + 4,000 texts (2,000 complete pairs, fidelity-first selection, min 80%) from one SG04 generator; 7 BERTs, 3 seeds, SR05 recipe. No random control. Member = <classifier>_<generator>.
runs.SR08: Repair test on SR07 (D-025, test-contaminated like SR07): S1 train + SG04 without the prayer pairs (3,600 texts); 3 BERTs (MARBERTv2, AraBERTv02-Tw, CAMeLBERT-mix), 3 seeds, SR07 recipe. Member = <classifier>_<generator>.
runs.SR09: Repair test on SR07 (D-025, test-contaminated like SR07): S1 train + SG04 Qwen3 without the pairs whose sides have the same words; 3 BERTs, 3 seeds, SR07 recipe. Member = <classifier>_qwen3.
runs.SR10: Repair test on SR07 (D-025, test-contaminated like SR07): two-stage training, epochs 1-2 on S1 train + SG04, epoch 3 on S1 train only; 3 BERTs, 3 seeds, otherwise SR07 recipe. Member = <classifier>_<generator>.
runs.SR11: Repair test on SR07 (D-025, test-contaminated like SR07): SR08 + SR10 together: SG04 without the prayer pairs, epochs 1-2 on S1 train + the set, epoch 3 on S1 train only; 3 BERTs, 3 seeds, otherwise SR07 recipe. Member = <classifier>_<generator>.
runs.SR12: SR11 without the NEU generations (D-026, test-contaminated like SR07): S1 train + the whole POS/NEG pairs of SG04 (sarcastic praise, emoji in context; 1,600 texts), epochs 1-2 on S1 train + the set, epoch 3 on S1 train only; 3 BERTs, 3 seeds, otherwise SR11 recipe. Member = <classifier>_<generator>.
runs.SR13: SR12 + the NEG sides of the SG04 public jab and personal remark pairs (D-026, test-contaminated like SR07): 2,600 texts, pairs of those types broken, NEU sides dropped; otherwise SR12 recipe. SR13 - SR12 = effect of those 1,000 NEG sides. Member = <classifier>_<generator>.
runs.SR12-3600: SR12 at the size of SR11 (D-027, test-contaminated like SR07): S1 train + SG04-PN (1,800 POS/NEG pairs, 3,600 texts, fidelity of SR12 per type), epochs 1-2 on S1 train + the set, epoch 3 on S1 train only; 3 BERTs, 3 seeds, otherwise SR11 recipe. Member = <classifier>_<generator>.
runs.SR01-EESA: Real only on EESA (data version E2, D-032): EESA train 2,463 / dev 818 / test 818, the 7 BERTs, 3 seeds, SR01 recipe. Baseline for SR02-EESA.
runs.SR02-EESA: EESA real + SG01-EESA (D-032): EESA train + 1,320 texts generated for EESA (prompt open_eesa_v1, 440 per sentiment, 0.54 x real as in SR02), from one generator; 7 BERTs, 3 seeds. Member = <classifier>_<generator>.
runs.SR05-EESA: SR03-EESA BERT runs repeated with 8 epochs instead of 3 (Ammar, 2026-11-14; every 3-epoch run kept its last epoch); nothing else changes (epoch by training loss, D-035). Members <classifier> = real only; <classifier>_<generator> = EESA train + 1,320 SG01-EESA texts. 7 BERTs x 3 seeds, no LLM classifiers. Baseline for SR06-EESA and SR06-random-EESA. The ID was first reserved for a minimal-pair plan (SG03-EESA) that was never run.
runs.SR06-EESA: SR04-EESA BERT runs repeated with 8 epochs instead of 3 (Ammar, 2026-11-14): EESA train + 1,320 SG02-EESA texts (targeted few-shot, DEV-CONTAMINATED, D-034); epoch by training loss; 7 BERTs x 3 seeds, no LLM classifiers. Member = <classifier>_<generator>. The ID was first reserved for a minimal-pair control (SG03-random-EESA) that was never run.
runs.SR02-EESA-XFER: TRANSFER RUN, not an EESA result (D-032 revised): EESA real + SG01 subset (D-032): EESA train + 1,320 SG01 texts (110 per variety x sentiment cell, 22% of the set, so synthetic = 0.54 x real as in SR02), from one generator; 7 BERTs, 3 seeds. Member = <classifier>_<generator>. Stopped 2026-11-08 07:08 after 15 runs (seed 42, MARBERTv2 and MARBERT); renamed from sr0N_eesa_* (results/sentiment/renames_2026-11-08.json).
runs.SR05-EESA-XFER: TRANSFER RUN, not an EESA result (D-032 revised): EESA real + SG03 subset (D-032): EESA train + 880 SG03 texts (440 whole pairs, pair types in SR05 shares; synthetic = 0.36 x real as in SR05); 7 BERTs, 3 seeds. SG03 targets ArSarcasm-v2 dev hard cases, not EESA. Member = <classifier>_<generator>. Stopped 2026-11-08 07:08 after 15 runs (seed 42, MARBERTv2 and MARBERT); renamed from sr0N_eesa_* (results/sentiment/renames_2026-11-08.json).
runs.SR06-EESA-XFER: TRANSFER RUN, not an EESA result (D-032 revised): EESA real + SG03-random subset (D-032), the size-matched control for SR05-EESA: EESA train + 880 SG03-random texts (440 whole pairs, 0.36 x real); 7 BERTs, 3 seeds. Member = <classifier>_<generator>. Stopped 2026-11-08 07:08 after 15 runs (seed 42, MARBERTv2 and MARBERT); renamed from sr0N_eesa_* (results/sentiment/renames_2026-11-08.json).
runs.SR04-EESA: EESA real + SG02-EESA (D-034), DEV-CONTAMINATED: EESA train + 1,320 few-shot texts aimed at 4 SG01-most-errors types (examples are EESA dev texts); epoch by training loss (D-035); 7 BERTs, 3 seeds. Member = <classifier>_<generator>. LLM classifiers (Qwen3, Aya, Fanar, Jais-2, Falcon-H1; seed 42 only; no LLM on its own generator's set) are members too.
runs.SR04-random-EESA: EESA real + SG02-random-EESA (D-034), size-matched control for SR04-EESA: EESA train + 1,320 few-shot texts with 5 random EESA train examples per request, same class mix; epoch by training loss (D-035); 7 BERTs, 3 seeds. Member = <classifier>_<generator>. LLM classifiers (Qwen3, Aya, Fanar, Jais-2, Falcon-H1; seed 42 only; no LLM on its own generator's set) are members too.
runs.SR03-EESA: SR01-EESA and SR02-EESA rerun with the epoch chosen by training loss (D-035; in practice the last epoch), so EESA dev chooses nothing; named SR03 by Ammar (2026-11-12). Members <classifier> = real only; <classifier>_<generator> = EESA train + 1,320 SG01-EESA texts. 7 BERTs x 3 seeds, plus the LLM classifiers (Qwen3, Aya, Fanar, Jais-2, Falcon-H1; seed 42 only; no LLM on its own generator's set). Baseline for SR04-EESA and SR04-random-EESA. Folders keep their names (sr01_eesa_tl_*, sr02_eesa_tl_*, sr01_eesa_<llm>, sr02_eesa_<llm>_<generator>).
runs.SR06-random-EESA: SR04-random-EESA BERT runs repeated with 8 epochs instead of 3 (Ammar, 2026-11-14): EESA train + 1,320 SG02-random-EESA texts (random-example few-shot, D-034); epoch by training loss; 7 BERTs x 3 seeds, no LLM classifiers. Member = <classifier>_<generator>.
runs.SR07-EESA-NM: EESA real + SG03-EESA-NM (matrix-language pilot, D-037): EESA train + 1,320 zero-shot texts whose prompt asks for code-switched comments with no matrix language stated; 3 epochs, epoch by training loss (D-035); 7 BERTs, 3 seeds, no LLM classifiers. Member = <classifier>_<generator>. Baseline SR03-EESA.
runs.SR07-EESA-DM: EESA real + SG03-EESA-DM (matrix-language pilot, D-037): EESA train + 1,320 zero-shot texts whose prompt asks for code-switched comments with Egyptian Arabic stated as the matrix language, English words inserted; 3 epochs, epoch by training loss (D-035); 7 BERTs, 3 seeds, no LLM classifiers. Member = <classifier>_<generator>. Baseline SR03-EESA.
runs.SR07-EESA-EM: EESA real + SG03-EESA-EM (matrix-language pilot, D-037): EESA train + 1,320 zero-shot texts whose prompt asks for code-switched comments with English stated as the matrix language, Egyptian Arabic words inserted; 3 epochs, epoch by training loss (D-035); 7 BERTs, 3 seeds, no LLM classifiers. Member = <classifier>_<generator>. Baseline SR03-EESA.
runs.SR07-EESA-DM3: EESA real + SG03-EESA-DM3 (matrix-language pilot, D-037 addendum): EESA train + 1,320 zero-shot texts from the dialect-matrix prompt v3 (reworded to insert English: 'Every comment must contain English words ...' with example words); 3 epochs, epoch by training loss (D-035); 7 BERTs, 3 seeds, no LLM classifiers. Member = <classifier>_<generator>. Baseline SR03-EESA.
runs.SR08-EESA-NM: SR07-EESA-NM BERT runs repeated with 8 epochs instead of 3 (D-036 recipe; D-037): EESA train + 1,320 SG03-EESA-NM texts (no matrix language stated); epoch by training loss; 7 BERTs x 3 seeds, no LLM classifiers. Member = <classifier>_<generator>. Baseline SR05-EESA (real only, 8 epochs).
runs.SR08-EESA-DM: SR07-EESA-DM BERT runs repeated with 8 epochs instead of 3 (D-036 recipe; D-037): EESA train + 1,320 SG03-EESA-DM texts (Egyptian Arabic as matrix, prompt v2; Qwen3 set only); epoch by training loss; 7 BERTs x 3 seeds, no LLM classifiers. Member = <classifier>_<generator>. Baseline SR05-EESA (real only, 8 epochs).

Member = <classifier>_<generator>. Baseline SR05-EESA (real only, 8 epochs).
runs.SR08-EESA-EM: SR07-EESA-EM BERT runs repeated with 8 epochs instead of 3 (D-036 recipe; D-037): EESA train + 1,320 SG03-EESA-EM texts (English as matrix); epoch by training loss; 7 BERTs x 3 seeds, no LLM classifiers. Member = <classifier>_<generator>. Baseline SR05-EESA (real only, 8 epochs).
runs.SR09-EESA: EESA real + SG04-EESA (D-038): EESA train + 2,640 generated dislike comments (1,320 NEG / 1,320 NEU; few-shot examples = the 15 EESA dev dislike comments most 8-epoch BERT runs get wrong, dev-contaminated); 7 BERTs, 3 seeds, 8 epochs, epoch by training loss (SR05-EASA recipe); baseline SR05-EESA real only. Member = <classifier>_<generator>.
runs.SR09-random-EESA: EESA real + SG04-random-EESA (D-038), the size-matched control for SR09-EESA: 2,640 dislike comments with random EESA train dislike comments as examples; 7 BERTs, 3 seeds, 8 epochs. Member = <classifier>_<generator>.
